Theorem
[Problem 1: first-order equation with constant reaction term]

↗ thm:transport-ivp-solution ↗ thm:transport-initial-condition \group Transport Equation

For constants $c\in \R $, $b\in \R ^n$, the function \[ u(x,t)=e^{-ct}g(x-tb) \] satisfies \[ u_t+b\cdot Du+cu=0, \qquad u(x,0)=g(x). \]
Proof

\sketch The transport factor is constant along $(b,1)$, while the derivative of $e^{-ct}$ contributes $-cu$. At $t=0$ the exponential equals $1$.

□
